maria (sec): noticed customer reports of SCIM 403s after RBAC cleanup. raising in thread.
lee (idp): quick look at identity logs: unwrap failed with encryption_context_mismatch. role_hash changed after slug normalization.
jordan (sre): how widespread?
lee (idp): small: 9 deprovision failures across two tenants in last 2h. not a full outage, but stuck jobs.
maria (sec): ok impact low but compliance needs audit trail. keep it controlled.
lee (idp): plan: dry-run rewrap for tenant "blueleaf" then canary rewrap batch of 50. tool: `python tools/identity_rewrap.py --tenant blueleaf --dry-run`
jordan (sre): add automatic pause if >5% errors and emit audit.tx for each batch.
deploy-bot: job identity-rewrap-runner started at 2026-03-02T22:05:00Z
lee (idp): dry-run found 11 candidates. proceeding with canary now. will monitor scim queue.
jordan (sre): canary complete: 11 rewrapped, scim queue drained. no failures.
maria (sec): open tech-debt to remove mutable role_hash from KMS context (use role_id) and attach audit logs to ticket.
lee (idp): filed IDP-812. will follow up with migration schedule and runbook update.
maria (sec): thanks team. closing loop after compliance sign-off.
